messages:
alex_sales: Hey team — ACME Fin needs clarification on BYO-KMS cutover and how it impacts pricing + timeline. They want: 1) Key ceremony/hand-off window (we propose a hard cutover) 2) Rotation frequency / escrow options for regulatory audit 3) Whether replication across us-east/us-west is supported with BYO-HSM 4) Rough delta vs our default hosted CMK pricing. Any blockers?
ricardo_cryptoops: Quick answers: we support BYO-HSM (CloudHSM/Thales) in Private and Dedicated. Replication across regions is supported but requires cross-site HSM replication config + networking. Cutover: prefer a scheduled key ceremony + can do a staged canary rollout for traffic.
maya_security: To add — for audits we provide key rotation logs and HSM audit trails, but we don’t accept plaintext key import outside an approved ceremony. If they need escrow we recommend a dual-custodian flow and a recorded ceremony.
julia_se: For timeline: typical POC with BYO takes 3 weeks from contract to first ceremony (network, HSM verifications, test keystore). If they want multi-region replication add 1–2 weeks.
chris_solutions: Pricing wise — two parts: (a) Dedicated/private infra delta (reserve + per-GPU/hr) and (b) BYO-HSM integration fee + ongoing HSM management surcharge. Ballpark: integration/setup fee, then ~10–25% premium on Dedicated unit economics depending on HSM count/replication. Need to confirm with finance for exact quote. :money_with_wings:
alex_sales: Perfect. Can we get phrasing for the SOW and a checklist I can send to the customer? Also they asked if rotation can be automated or must be manual.
ricardo_cryptoops: Rotation options: automated rotation (we can trigger rewrap of model keys against new CMK) if customer allows Redwood-managed key wrapping using their CMK in HSM (we perform operations inside HSM). For strict custody customers, rotation is performed by their HSM operator and we support rollovers via a handshake API.
maya_security: Checklist (short): 1) Network allowlist for HSM endpoints 2) HSM firmware + key origin proof 3) Access controls and custodian list 4) Escrow/dual-custodian plan 5) Rotation window and SLAs 6) Audit log delivery method.
chris_solutions: SOW snippet: ```BYO-KMS Integration: Redwood will validate customer HSM inventory, perform network connectivity tests, coordinate key ceremony, and enable rotation APIs. Delivery: staging + prod cutover windows. Acceptance: successful key-encrypted inference test and audit log verification.```
alex_sales: Nice. Customer also has a security questionnaire item: "Does Redwood ever have access to unencrypted customer keys?" How to answer succinctly?
maya_security: Answer: No. Redwood does not persist or export plaintext customer master keys; all cryptographic operations happen inside the HSM under customer custody or within shielded Redwood-managed HSM contexts where keys never leave the module. Provide HSM attestation docs and our KMS architecture diagram.
julia_se: One blocker we hit before: network egress rules in their VPC can block attestation. Recommend we include a pre-check step for their infra team to open port X and allow AWS KMS/CloudHSM endpoints.
alex_sales: Got it. I'll ping infra contact at ACME. Can someone prepare a short quote with the ranges you mentioned so I can attach to the email? Need it by EOD tomorrow.
chris_solutions: I'll draft a range and include optional items (replication + escrow). Expect a draft in 6 hours.
ricardo_cryptoops: I'll assemble the tech checklist + key ceremony runbook (short doc, 1–2 pages).
qa-bot: security-questionnaire.pdf uploaded to the thread: https://redwood.internal/qa/attachments/ACME-sec-q.pdf :white_check_mark:
alex_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll attach the SOW snippet and the security pdf and loop legal if they push nonstandard escrow terms. :thumbsup:
